peerGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (RCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

positions.label: Price position
positions.statement: Price position — In line with comparable condos: 3.3% below its local comparables; 68 of 130 similar developments with a figure have a lower relative price (a position, not a measure of value).

positions.label: Resale activity
positions.statement: Resale activity — Below peers (24.8): 2 resales per 100 homes a year (24 months): higher than 96 of 393 similar developments with a figure (the same as 3). Context, not scored: resales in 70.8% of months (24 months).

comparisonGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (RCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

profile.rule: Each line compares this development with its own comparison group; numbers from different groups are not comparable. There is no overall score.
profile.surroundingMarket: Surrounding market: other condo and EC developments within 2 km (straight line between development positions); new sales plus resales; subsales, cluster and other landed housing, HDB flats and this development are excluded. Competition, the quiet-area check and the Market backdrop use this same set.

lines.label: Entry price against comparable developments
lines.statement: 3-bedroom: median $3,388,888 ($2,265 psf, 1,323–1,862 sq ft; 9 resales, Sep 2025–Aug 2026); 8 comparable developments within 3 km: median $2,343 psf (range $1,514–2,460); 3.3% below; illustrative entry-price difference about $117,000 less. The entry-price difference is illustrative: the median price adjusted to the comparable median psf, for a similar-size unit. A premium or a discount is not in itself an advantage or a disadvantage.

lines.label: Sustained resale activity
lines.statement: No first resale wave in the observation period: sustained activity is the observed activity.

lines.label: MRT today
lines.statement: King Albert Park MRT about 140 m, Beauty World MRT about 1,130 m; closer than 617 of 662 similar developments (the same as 8). Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Primary schools
lines.statement: 2 within 1 km and 3 within 2 km; nearest Methodist Girls' School (Primary) about 230 m; more than 292 of 662 similar developments (the same as 254). Straight-line distances. MOE measures distance for school admission differently.

lines.label: Everyday amenities
lines.statement: 4 supermarkets within 1 km (nearest about 230 m), more than 151 of 662 similar developments (the same as 25); nearest hawker centre Bukit Timah Market about 1,030 m; nearest park Rail Corridor about 370 m. Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Future transport
lines.statement: Not yet assessed: needs official LTA evidence for planned stations.

lines.label: Recorded new-launch competition
lines.statement: 6 other condo developments sold new homes within 2 km (Amberwood at Holland, 24 new sales, about 830 m; The Reserve Residences, 2 new sales, about 970 m; Dunearn House, 237 new sales, about 1,020 m; 8@BT, 34 new sales, about 1,120 m; Pinetree Hill, 58 new sales, about 1,890 m; Nava Grove, 77 new sales, about 1,960 m). Surrounding market, Oct 2025–Sep 2026: 79 other condo and EC developments within 2 km recorded 432 new sales and 357 resales (789 purchases); new sales were 54.8% of these purchases. Subsales (45) and this development’s own transactions are excluded. New sales as a share of local private purchases is a measure of market activity, not of supply pressure.

lines.label: Unsold inventory

missing.reason: not available until the URA-based launched-unsold measure (S3) passes the V1 local validation; no other inventory source is used

lines.statement: Not available: unsold inventory has not been validated.

lines.label: Known pipeline

missing.reason: known sites only; not a complete pipeline

lines.statement: Within 2 km: Holland Plain GLS site (government land sale site, awarded), about 800 m; Dunearn Road GLS site (government land sale site, awarded), about 900 m. Known sites only; not a complete pipeline.

lines.label: Quiet-area check
lines.statement: Quiet area: local resales are among the lowest 30% of similar developments, so little nearby competition reflects a thin market, not an advantage. 357 resales within 2 km in Oct 2025–Sep 2026, more than 73 of 662 similar developments.

lines.label: Market backdrop
lines.statement: Condo and EC resales within 2 km: 357 in Oct 2025–Sep 2026 against 396 in Oct 2024–Sep 2025 (−9.8%). Planning-area private resales −4.6%. Observed transactions, not a prediction.
